title: Compound Primitive
description: Compound primitive registry entry. Compound primitives express choreography that CSS keyframes cannot — physics-driven motion, multi-target timelines, phase state machines. Two flavors: 'remotion-native' (bespoke Remotion component, default) and 'library-driven' (delegates to a vetted external library — gsap or motion). The library-driven flavor was added in ANI-143; pre-existing compound entries default to remotion-native.

slug.description: Unique slug. Convention: prefix-name (e.g. bd-card-conveyor, lib-gsap-spring-stagger).

source.description: All entries in catalog/compound/ have source: compound.

flavor.description: remotion-native: bespoke Remotion component (existing entries). library-driven: delegates to an approved external library.

requires_js.description: Always true for compound primitives (kept for back-compat with legacy entries).

entry_point.description: Required when flavor=remotion-native. Path to physics module (e.g. src/remotion/physics/card-conveyor.js).

remotion_component.description: Required when flavor=remotion-native. Path to React component (e.g. src/remotion/compositions/CardConveyorLayer.jsx).

library.description: Required when flavor=library-driven. Pins the external library this primitive delegates to.

name.description: Approved libraries only. Adding a new entry to this enum requires a determinism spike (see ANI-143 spec).

version.description: Semver range. Validator checks this satisfies a range present in package.json.

capture_contract.description: Required when flavor=library-driven. Declares what the primitive needs from the deterministic capture pipeline.

needs_adapter.description: True for gsap (lagSmoothing must be disabled), false for motion (rides on patched rAF).

boot_ms.description: Wall-clock ms the prototype needs to render its first frame. Capture pipeline default is 600ms.

real_time_dependencies.description: Explicit list of any real-time dependencies (scroll, pointermove, IntersectionObserver). Must be empty for capture-deterministic primitives.

prototype_template.description: Required when flavor=library-driven. Path (relative to repo root) to a self-contained HTML prototype that demonstrates this primitive and meets the capture contract.
